'''Sarutahiko Shrine''' (猿田彦神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} dedicated to {{ill|Sarutahiko Ōkami|en|Sarutahiko Ōkami|qid=Q3090037|lt=Sarutahiko Ōkami}}, enshrined under this name. Such shrines are found throughout Japan, with {{ill|Tsubaki Grand Shrine|en|Tsubaki Grand Shrine|qid=Q3541617|lt=Tsubaki Grand Shrine}} in {{ill|Suzuka, Mie|en|Suzuka, Mie|qid=Q207311|lt=Suzuka, Mie}} claiming to be the "Sarutahiko Grand Shrine Headquarters."
